FortressTV FFmpeg build configuration
=====================================

AndroidX Media3 version: 1.10.1
AndroidX Media3 commit: 5fb306449733dd71595700c1227ad6087578c559
FFmpeg branch: release/6.0
FFmpeg commit: 3f92512fd1fd6f5e6d6eb45a156c352835314d69
Android NDK: r26b (26.1.10909125)
Host platform: linux-x86_64
Android ABI level: 26
Enabled decoders: mp3

Official build command:

./build_ffmpeg.sh \
  <media3>/libraries/decoder_ffmpeg/src/main \
  <android-ndk-r26b> \
  linux-x86_64 \
  26 \
  mp3

The AndroidX Media3 module was then packaged with:

./gradlew lib-decoder-ffmpeg:clean lib-decoder-ffmpeg:assembleRelease

No local changes were made to the FFmpeg source tree. GPL and non-free
components were not enabled. The resulting FFmpeg configuration reports
"License: LGPL version 2.1 or later".
